description: The account's address plan: the account address, every managed domain, subdomain and connected hostname with what is shown at its root, and the tree of all works (websites with pages, forms and shops with their path). Call it before you set a path or choose what a domain shows — ids of works (id), domains (domain_id) and hostnames (custom_id) come ONLY from here.
name: get_address_plan
title: Read address plan
